event_chain.summary: Employee phished from compromised partner mailbox
Stolen credentials used on cloud work account

summary: Eskenazi Health, an Indianapolis safety-net health system, was hit by a social engineering attack beginning June 3, 2026 and discovered July 27, 2026. A threat actor took over a trusted business contact's email account and sent phishing emails with document notifications; an Eskenazi employee clicked the link and entered credentials, which were used to access the employee's cloud-based work account. Patient demographics, contact, insurance and billing information, medical record numbers, medical and treatment information, Social Security numbers and substance use disorder information were compromised.
